about: The shape of a served agent's OpenAI chat completion, the same in both SDKs (2026-09-26, the new-developer e2e run's response-shape findings). A non-streaming `POST /chat/completions` answers one `chat.completion` whose `created` is a positive Unix timestamp and whose `usage` sums EVERY model call of the turn (a tool turn is two calls); a tool call the agent hands back to the client (a tool it does not have) is labelled `chat.completion` too, with `finish_reason` `tool_calls` and the call under `message.tool_calls`, never a chunk with a `delta`. A streamed answer's chunks each carry `id`, `object` (`chat.completion.chunk`), `created` and `model` beside `choices`. Python answered `created: null`, only the last call's usage, and a handed-back call as a `chat.completion.chunk`; TypeScript's chunks carried `choices` alone. Read by python/tests/server/test_completion_shapes_e2efix.py and typescript/tests/unit/server/completion-shapes-e2efix.test.ts.

created.rule: a positive integer Unix timestamp on the finished completion and on EVERY chunk of a stream, one value per stream, stamped by the agent when the model sent none (2026-09-27, the final e2e re-run: Python streamed `created: null` and the daemon's merged completion took the first chunk's null). TypeScript: server/handler.ts `meta`; Python: BaseAgent.run_streaming and the completions transport's merge. Read by python/tests/server/test_created_timestamp_finalfix.py.
